title: All Up In Abaddon's Family Business
description: All Up In Abaddon's Family Business — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Wow, you really went through Abaddon's family tree and hit them all with the beatdown stick! I can only imagine how much fun that must have been. So much fun that you probably want to go and take that beatdown stick to each and every one of them again. Am I right? Well, good for you because the Abaddon Family Tree has respawn = true!

You have walked this path already, so I don't have to walk you through every step. Just return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal when you have killed Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon. No big deal.

Turn-in:

You did it? Wow, um, I have to be honest here and say that I never really expected you to finish this quest...and I don't really have anything to give you as reward. Oh, no, I have some King's Coin saved up for a rainy day right here in my sock. Let me know, if for some unexplicable reason, you want to try this quest again so I can put some more King's Coin in my sock to warm them up for you.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abazabaddon
  • Kill Abadabadooddon
  • Kill Abracadabraddonna
  • Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna
  • Kill Abadumdadumdummmddon
  • Kill Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna
  • Kill Abaddon

Level range: 47–100
